attempts.task: M00-T05-go-round2-fix (round-1 adversarial review defects; slice-contract §9.1 K6a, K13-K16; K3a on Linux)
attempts.verdict_note: Every counted check passes on darwin-arm64 (native) and linux-arm64 (native arm64 kernel in digest-pinned containers): Go tests, selftest 68/68 (alpine/ash and bookworm/bash), K15 probe 32/32, agent probe 34/34, reviewer pipeline probe 7/7. One K6a clause is NOT met and cannot be met without routing around the Go runtime: a SIGQUIT (also SIGTERM, SIGWINCH) that heimdall-proto inherited as ignored is reset to the default in the child and is forwarded (observed: selftest OBSERVE line, child SIGQUIT=dfl, on darwin and Linux; informational shared-harness run.k6a_inherited_ignore [async-job] child SIGQUIT SIG_DFL, heimdall exit 131). Hence fail for the contract criterion; Windows not executed.
attempts.summary: Fixed: K3a (reset after >=1 byte -> AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR; verified on Linux arm64 with real ECONNRESET), K6a pipeline/job transparency (new mode model: child stays in heimdall's group when heimdall shares its group or stdin/stdout is a pipe; own group + foreground only when heimdall is alone in its group), K6a inherited SIGINT/SIGHUP ignore, controlling terminal found through /dev/tty when not on stdio, K14 (non-regular --file -> USAGE_ERROR without blocking), K15 (structural pre-scan guard before BurntSushi/toml: depth 32, 65536 units, 2 MiB key-path bytes), K16 (color profile detected without `tmux info`), GODEBUG=execerrdot=0 cannot re-enable '.' PATH matches, FIFO --meta-file no longer blocks, darwin artifact signed ad-hoc with hardened runtime (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES ignored), doc fixes (LICENSES termios/colorprofile, Filter comment), tests relocatable via HEIMDALL_G02_FIXTURES. Stack limitation: inherited-ignored SIGQUIT/SIGTERM/SIGWINCH (Go runtime installs its handler regardless; os/signal.Ignored reports only SIGINT/SIGHUP); no siginfo in os/signal, so in shared mode an explicit SIGINT/SIGQUIT/SIGWINCH/SIGHUP sent to heimdall's PID while its group is the terminal foreground is not forwarded. Every fix has a native test that fails on the round-1 sources/artifact and passes now.

K6a stack limitation (Go): SIGQUIT, SIGTERM and SIGWINCH inherited as ignored are reset to the default in the child and forwarded; os/signal exposes no siginfo, so in shared mode (pipeline or shared process group, terminal present) an explicit SIGINT/SIGQUIT/SIGWINCH/SIGHUP sent to heimdall's PID while its group is the terminal foreground is not forwarded, and a killpg of the shared group delivers SIGTERM/SIGHUP twice.

K6a mode choice is a heuristic over observable state (process-group membership via sysctl/proc, stdin/stdout pipe or socket, controlling terminal). A process that joins heimdall's group after the start check without a pipe on stdin/stdout is not detected until the next foreground handoff check; job-control stop mirroring in exclusive mode does not re-check membership.
K15 guard bounds were chosen from measurements of BurntSushi/toml v1.6.0 on 32 shapes; a shape not modeled could cost more per unit. Worst accepted case observed 77.1 MiB / 0.083 s.

Ctrl-Z / bg / fg sequences after a stop are still not automated (implemented_unverified). The 50 ms foreground watcher, PID-reuse window after reap on macOS, and SIGKILL of heimdall leaving the child (exclusive and no-tty modes) are unchanged.
